---
title: "Trillet voice AI API and platform overview"
sidebarTitle: "Introduction"
description: "Trillet is a voice AI API and platform for AI phone agents, phone numbers, outbound calls and workflows, with MCP for AI assistants, white-label and OEM."
---

Trillet is a voice AI API and platform for building AI phone agents that answer and place calls, chat on your website and hand off to people when needed. You can build agents in the dashboard, with the REST API, or from an AI assistant over MCP, then connect phone numbers, run batch outbound calls and automate follow-up with workflows. Calls start from $0.12 per minute and phone numbers from $4.99 per month.

<Note>
**For AI agents and LLMs.** A full index of these docs is at [/llms.txt](https://docs.trillet.ai/llms.txt) and the complete text is at [/llms-full.txt](https://docs.trillet.ai/llms-full.txt). Add `.md` to any page URL to get its Markdown source. The Trillet OEM OpenAPI spec is at [trillet-oem.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TrilletAI/trillet-ai-docs/main/public/openapi/trillet-oem.json).
</Note>

## Getting Started

1. Sign up for an API key at [app.trillet.ai](https://app.trillet.ai)
2. Follow our [Quick Start Guide](/documentation/quickstart) to make your first API call
3. Explore our [API Reference](/v1/api-reference/introduction) for detailed endpoint documentation
